    cubes = [i^3 FOR i IN [1, 2, 3, 4]]

    sums_of_cubes = SET()

        i = 5
        WHILE i * i <= n:
            IF n % i = 0 OR n % (i + 2) = 0 THEN RETURN FALSE
            i = i + 6
        RETURN TRUE
    
    // Find smallest prime among two-digit sums
    prime_sums = [x IN two_digit_sums WHERE is_prime(x)]
